books.title: In Her Own League
books.author: Liz Tomforde
books.description:
Reese Remington has inherited a Major League Baseball team and a whole lot of men who think they could run it better. As the league's first female team owner, she's determined to prove she belongs, even if it means making unpopular decisions.

Enter Emmett Montgomery, the team's beloved field manager, who disagrees with practically everything she does. Unfortunately, he's also infuriatingly attractive.

With a baseball season to survive, careers on the line, and an attraction neither can afford, Reese and Emmett are about to discover just how complicated mixing business with pleasure can get.
books.curator_note: I love this book so much! I cannot wait for you all to meet Emmett Montgomery. I've still got a lot to read this year, but Emmett is my current favourite book boyfriend
books.content_notes: Women in leadership, sexism, ambition, vulnerability, trust, and love after loss.
books.scene_skip_guide: 24, 29, 32, 35, and Epilogue 1. These are the identified explicit scenes, but the list may not be exhaustive.
books.reading_guide:
Chapters 1–10: Meet the characters, explore the world of professional baseball, and get a feel for the dynamics at play.
Chapters 11–21: Navigate workplace politics, competing priorities, and complicated professional relationships.
Chapters 22–32: Explore personal ambitions, evolving relationships, and the pressures of life in the spotlight.
Chapters 33–42 + Epilogues: See how the season, its challenges, and the characters' stories come together.
